ko.title: 쇼퍼들의 속도 조절: 10월 소매판매 0.2% 증가가 연휴 시즌에 대해 말해주는 것

segments.src: After a strong September, American shoppers eased off the gas in October.
segments.tr: 강한 9월을 보낸 후, 미국 소비자들이 10월에는 지출 속도를 늦췄습니다.

segments.src: Retail sales rose 0.2% for the month, according to the Census Bureau's advance estimate, following a 0.8% jump in September.
segments.tr: 인구조사국의 속보치에 따르면 10월 소매판매는 9월의 0.8% 급증에 이어 한 달 동안 0.2% 증가했습니다.

segments.src: The October figure matched what forecasters had expected, so it was not a surprise.
segments.tr: 10월 수치는 전문가들이 예상했던 수준과 일치하여 놀라움은 없었습니다.

segments.src: It still gives us a useful chance to look at how consumers are behaving heading into the busiest shopping stretch of the year.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 이는 한 해 중 가장 바쁜 쇼핑 시기에 접어들며 소비자들이 어떻게 행동하고 있는지 살펴볼 수 있는 유용한 기회를 제공합니다.

segments.src: This article explains how to read the report, why fuel prices can squeeze other spending, and what the numbers may and may not tell us about the holidays.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 보고서를 읽는 법, 연료 가격이 다른 지출을 압박하는 이유, 그리고 이 수치가 연휴에 대해 무엇을 알려주고 무엇을 알려주지 않는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보이며 재정적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## The numbers in context
segments.tr: ## 맥락 속의 수치

segments.src: Retail sales measure the dollar value of purchases at stores, restaurants, online retailers, gas stations and other businesses.
segments.tr: 소매판매는 상점, 식당, 온라인 소매업체, 주유소 및 기타 기업에서의 구매 달러 가치를 측정합니다.

segments.src: The monthly report is one of the most closely watched indicators of consumer demand.
segments.tr: 월간 보고서는 소비자 수요를 가장 주의 깊게 관찰하는 지표 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: 소비자 지출은 미국 경제 활동의 약 3분의 2를 차지하므로,

segments.src: economic activity, so shifts in shopping habits matter well beyond store aisles.
segments.tr: 쇼핑 습관의 변화는 매장 통로를 넘어 큰 의미를 갖습니다.

segments.src: A 0.8% gain followed by a 0.2% gain does not mean consumers have stopped spending.
segments.tr: 0.8% 증가에 이어진 0.2% 증가가 소비자들이 지출을 멈췄다는 것을 의미하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Sales are still growing.
segments.tr: 매출은 여전히 성장하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The pace has simply cooled from an unusually strong month.
segments.tr: 속도가 유난히 강했던 달에 비해 진정되었을 뿐입니다.

segments.src: Economists often expect some "give-back" after a big jump, because a surge in one month can pull forward purchases that would otherwise have happened later.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 한 달 동안의 급증이 나중에 일어났어야 할 구매를 앞당겨 가져왔을 수 있기 때문에 큰 폭의 상승 후에는 어느 정도의 "되돌림"을 예상하곤 합니다.

segments.src: ## How to read a Census Bureau retail report
segments.tr: ## 인구조사국 소매 보고서를 읽는 법

segments.src: A single headline number hides a lot.
segments.tr: 단 하나의 헤드라인 수치는 많은 것을 숨깁니다.

segments.src: A few habits help when you read the release.
segments.tr: 발표 자료를 읽을 때 몇 가지 습관이 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: Check whether the figures are adjusted.** The headline number is usually seasonally adjusted, which smooths out predictable patterns such as holiday spikes and summer travel.
segments.tr: 수치가 조정되었는지 확인하세요.** 헤드라인 수치는 보통 계절 조정되어 연휴 급증이나 여름 여행 같은 예측 가능한 패턴을 완화합니다.

segments.src: That makes month-to-month comparisons fairer.
segments.tr: 그 덕분에 월별 비교가 더 공정해집니다.

segments.src: Unadjusted figures show the raw totals.
segments.tr: 조정되지 않은 수치는 원본 총계를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Remember that prices are not removed.** Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars.
segments.tr: 가격이 제거되지 않았음을 기억하세요.** 소매판매는 명목 달러로 보고됩니다.

segments.src: If prices rise 0.3% in a month, sales can grow 0.2% while the actual quantity of goods bought falls slightly.
segments.tr: 만약 한 달 동안 물가가 0.3% 상승하면, 구매한 상품의 실제 수량은 약간 줄어들면서도 매출은 0.2% 성장할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Comparing the sales figure with inflation data gives a better picture of real demand.
segments.tr: 매출 수치를 인플레이션 데이터와 비교하면 실제 수요를 더 잘 파악할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Expect revisions.** The first estimate is an "advance" reading based on a sample of businesses.
segments.tr: 수정을 예상하세요.** 첫 번째 추정치는 기업 표본을 기반으로 한 "속보" 수치입니다.

segments.src: It is often revised in later releases, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: 이는 이후 발표에서 종종 수정되며, 때로는 의미 있는 수준으로 바뀝니다.

segments.src: A 0.2% reading could later be adjusted up or down, and the prior month's number can change too.
segments.tr: 0.2% 수치는 나중에 상향 또는 하향 조정될 수 있으며, 이전 달의 수치도 변경될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Look beneath the top line.** The report breaks sales into categories, including motor vehicles, building materials, grocery stores, restaurants, clothing, electronics and online retail.
segments.tr: 상위 지표 아래를 살펴보세요.** 보고서는 자동차, 건축 자재, 식료품점, 식당, 의류, 전자제품, 온라인 소매를 포함한 카테고리로 매출을 나눕니다.

segments.src: Many analysts also look at a narrower measure that excludes autos and gasoline, since those two categories can swing sharply with prices and supply and may obscure underlying trends.
segments.tr: 많은 분석가들은 자동차와 휘발유를 제외한 더 좁은 범위의 지표도 살펴보는데, 이 두 카테고리는 가격과 공급에 따라 급격히 흔들리며 기저의 추세를 모호하게 만들 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Compare against expectations.** Markets and commentators react less to the raw figure than to how it compares with forecasts.
segments.tr: 예상치와 비교하세요.** 시장과 평론가들은 원본 수치 그 자체보다 예상치와 어떻게 비교되는지에 더 반응합니다.

segments.src: A result in line with consensus, as in October, usually signals continuity rather than a turning point.
segments.tr: 10월처럼 컨센서스와 일치하는 결과는 보통 전환점보다는 연속성을 신호합니다.

segments.src: ## Why gasoline can crowd out other spending
segments.tr: ## 휘발유가 다른 지출을 밀어내는 이유

segments.src: Gas stations count as retail sales, so higher pump prices can lift the headline number even when people are not buying more of anything.
segments.tr: 주유소는 소매판매에 포함되므로, 사람들이 어떤 물건도 더 많이 사지 않을 때에도 주유소 가격이 오르면 헤드라인 수치가 올라갈 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Households do not have unlimited budgets, though.
segments.tr: 하지만 가계의 예산은 무한하지 않습니다.

segments.src: When a bigger share of income goes to fuel, there is less left for discretionary items like clothing, electronics, dining out and gifts.
segments.tr: 소득의 더 큰 부분이 연료로 들어가면, 의류, 전자제품, 외식, 선물 같은 재량 품목에 쓸 수 있는 돈이 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: That effect works in two directions:
segments.tr: 이러한 효과는 두 방향으로 작용합니다:

segments.src: - **Headline versus underlying strength.** A rise in fuel prices can make total sales look healthier than the rest of the economy actually is. Falling fuel prices can do the opposite, dragging down the total while leaving more money in household budgets for other purchases.
segments.tr: - **헤드라인 대 기저의 힘.** 연료 가격 상승은 전체 매출을 경제의 실제 상태보다 더 건강해 보이게 만들 수 있습니다. 반대로 연료 가격 하락은 총액을 끌어내리면서 가계 예산에 다른 구매를 위한 더 많은 돈을 남겨둘 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Squeezed budgets.** Gas is a necessity for most commuters. When it costs more, many families cut elsewhere, often on non-essential categories first. Lower-income households, which spend a larger share of income on fuel and other basics, tend to feel this most.
segments.tr: - **압박받는 예산.** 가스는 대부분의 통근자에게 필수품입니다. 비용이 더 많이 들면 많은 가족이 다른 곳에서 지출을 줄이며, 대개 비필수 카테고리에서 먼저 줄입니다. 연료 및 기타 기본생활비에 소득의 더 큰 부분을 지출하는 저소득 가구가 이를 가장 크게 느끼는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: This is why economists look at the "control group" and ex-gasoline measures as well as the total.
segments.tr: 이것이 바로 경제학자들이 총액뿐만 아니라 "통제 그룹" 및 휘발유 제외 지표를 살펴보는 이유입니다.

segments.src: They help separate real changes in shopping behavior from price movements in a single category.
segments.tr: 이들은 쇼핑 행동의 실제 변화를 단일 카테고리의 가격 변동과 분리하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for holiday sales
segments.tr: ## 연휴 매출에 의미하는 바

segments.src: It is tempting to treat one month of data as a forecast for November and December.
segments.tr: 한 달간의 데이터를 11월과 12월의 전망으로 취급하고 싶은 유혹이 듭니다.

segments.src: That would overreach.
segments.tr: 그것은 지나친 해석입니다.

segments.src: Still, a few points are reasonable.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 몇 가지 포인트는 합리적입니다.

segments.src: **Steady, not spectacular.** A modest gain suggests consumers are still spending but are more selective.
segments.tr: **화려하지 않지만 꾸준함.** 완만한 상승은 소비자들이 여전히 지출하고 있지만 더 까다로워졌음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: Retailers may see a season that grows at a moderate pace rather than one driven by a rush of impulse buying.
segments.tr: 소매업체들은 충동구매의 급증으로 이끌어지는 시즌보다는 완만한 속도로 성장하는 시즌을 맞이할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Promotions matter.** When shoppers are cautious, discounts and early sales events tend to carry more weight.
segments.tr: **프로모션의 중요성.** 쇼퍼들이 신중할 때 할인과 조기 세일 이벤트는 더 큰 무게를 갖는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Many retailers already start holiday promotions in October, which may pull some demand forward and affect how monthly numbers look.
segments.tr: 많은 소매업체들이 이미 10월에 연휴 프로모션을 시작하며, 이는 일부 수요를 앞당겨 가져오고 월간 수치의 모습에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Online keeps gaining share.** Over the long run, e-commerce has taken a growing portion of retail spending.
segments.tr: **온라인의 점유율 확대 지속.** 장기적으로 이커머스는 소매 지출의 점점 더 많은 부분을 차지해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Holiday results for physical stores and online sellers often diverge, so category detail is worth watching.
segments.tr: 오프라인 매장과 온라인 판매자의 연휴 결과는 종종 갈라지므로 카테고리 세부 정보를 지켜볼 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: **The big drivers are still ahead.** Employment, wage growth, borrowing costs and consumer confidence will shape the rest of the season.
segments.tr: **핵심 동력은 아직 앞에 있습니다.** 고용, 임금 상승, 차입 비용, 소비자 신뢰도가 남은 시즌을 형성할 것입니다.

segments.src: So will weather, shipping capacity and the timing of major sales days.
segments.tr: 날씨, 배송 용량, 주요 세일 날짜의 타이밍도 마찬가지입니다.

segments.src: No single data point settles the outcome.
segments.tr: 어떤 단일 데이터 포인트도 결과를 결정짓지 못합니다.

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for shoppers
segments.tr: **쇼퍼들을 위한 실용적인 시사점

segments.src: If you are planning your own holiday budget, the broader story is less important than your own finances.
segments.tr: 자신의 연휴 예산을 계획하고 있다면, 더 넓은 이야기보다 자신의 재정이 더 중요합니다.

segments.src: A few simple steps can help:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 간단한 단계가 도움이 될 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - Set a total spending limit before shopping starts, and divide it among gifts, travel and food.
segments.tr: - 쇼핑이 시작되기 전에 총 지출 한도를 설정하고 선물, 여행, 음식으로 나누세요.

segments.src: - Compare prices across several retailers, and check return policies.
segments.tr: - 여러 소매업체 간의 가격을 비교하고 반품 정책을 확인하세요.

segments.src: - Be wary of "limited time" pressure. A real bargain will usually still be a bargain tomorrow.
segments.tr: - "한정된 시간" 압박을 조심하세요. 진짜 할인 상품은 보통 내일도 여전히 할인 상품일 것입니다.

segments.src: - Try to avoid putting purchases on credit cards you cannot pay off promptly, since interest can erase any savings from a sale.
segments.tr: - 즉시 갚을 수 없는 신용카드로 구매하는 것은 피하세요. 이자가 세일로 얻은 모든 절약 효과를 지울 수 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: October's 0.2% increase shows a consumer who is still spending but at a calmer pace after September's burst.
segments.tr: 10월의 0.2% 인상은 9월의 급증 이후 소비자들이 여전히 지출하고 있지만 더 차분한 속도를 보이고 있음을 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Because the result matched expectations, it is best read as a sign of continuity.
segments.tr: 결과가 예상치와 일치했기 때문에, 이는 연속성의 신호로 읽는 것이 가장 좋습니다.

segments.src: For the holidays, the more useful questions are how much of the gain came from price changes rather than real purchases, how households are handling fuel and other living costs, and what the next reports show.
segments.tr: 연휴와 관련하여 더 유용한 질문들은 상승분의 얼마가 실제 구매가 아닌 가격 변화에서 왔는지, 가계가 연료 및 기타 생활비를 어떻게 처리하고 있는지, 그리고 다음 보고서가 무엇을 보여주는지입니다.

segments.src: Revisions and new data in the coming weeks will provide a clearer picture.
segments.tr: 다가오는 주의 수정치와 새로운 데이터는 더 명확한 그림을 제공할 것입니다.

es.title: Los compradores se desaceleran: Qué dice un aumento del 0.2% en las ventas minoristas de octubre sobre la temporada navideña

segments.src: After a strong September, American shoppers eased off the gas in October.
segments.tr: Después de un septiembre fuerte, los compradores estadounidenses levantaron el pie del acelerador en octubre.

segments.src: Retail sales rose 0.2% for the month, according to the Census Bureau's advance estimate, following a 0.8% jump in September.
segments.tr: Las ventas minoristas aumentaron un 0.2% en el mes, según la estimación preliminar de la Oficina del Censo, tras un salto del 0.8% en septiembre.

segments.src: The October figure matched what forecasters had expected, so it was not a surprise.
segments.tr: La cifra de octubre coincidió con lo que los pronosticadores esperaban, por lo que no fue una sorpresa.

segments.src: It still gives us a useful chance to look at how consumers are behaving heading into the busiest shopping stretch of the year.
segments.tr: Aun así, nos brinda una oportunidad útil para observar cómo se están comportando los consumidores de cara al tramo de compras más ocupado del año.

segments.src: This article explains how to read the report, why fuel prices can squeeze other spending, and what the numbers may and may not tell us about the holidays.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica cómo leer el informe, por qué los precios del combustible pueden presionar otros gastos y qué nos pueden decir —y qué no— los números sobre las fiestas.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento financiero.

segments.src: ## The numbers in context
segments.tr: ## Los números en contexto

segments.src: Retail sales measure the dollar value of purchases at stores, restaurants, online retailers, gas stations and other businesses.
segments.tr: Las ventas minoristas miden el valor en dólares de las compras en tiendas, restaurantes, minoristas en línea, gasolineras y otros negocios.

segments.src: The monthly report is one of the most closely watched indicators of consumer demand.
segments.tr: El informe mensual es uno de los indicadores de la demanda del consumidor que se sigue más de cerca.

segments.src: Consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: El gasto del consumidor representa aproximadamente dos tercios de la actividad económica de EE. UU.,

segments.src: economic activity, so shifts in shopping habits matter well beyond store aisles.
segments.tr: por lo que los cambios en los hábitos de compra importan mucho más allá de los pasillos de las tiendas.

segments.src: A 0.8% gain followed by a 0.2% gain does not mean consumers have stopped spending.
segments.tr: Una ganancia del 0.8% seguida de una ganancia del 0.2% no significa que los consumidores hayan dejado de gastar.

segments.src: Sales are still growing.
segments.tr: Las ventas siguen creciendo.

segments.src: The pace has simply cooled from an unusually strong month.
segments.tr: El ritmo simplemente se ha enfriado tras un mes inusualmente fuerte.

segments.src: Economists often expect some "give-back" after a big jump, because a surge in one month can pull forward purchases that would otherwise have happened later.
segments.tr: Los economistas a menudo esperan cierta "devolución" después de un gran salto, porque un aumento repentino en un mes puede adelantar compras que de otro modo habrían ocurrido más tarde.

segments.src: ## How to read a Census Bureau retail report
segments.tr: ## Cómo leer un informe minorista de la Oficina del Censo

segments.src: A single headline number hides a lot.
segments.tr: Una sola cifra principal oculta mucho.

segments.src: A few habits help when you read the release.
segments.tr: Unos cuantos hábitos ayudan al leer la publicación.

segments.src: Check whether the figures are adjusted.** The headline number is usually seasonally adjusted, which smooths out predictable patterns such as holiday spikes and summer travel.
segments.tr: Comprueba si las cifras están ajustadas.** La cifra principal suele estar ajustada por estacionalidad, lo que suaviza patrones predecibles como los picos navideños y los viajes de verano.

segments.src: That makes month-to-month comparisons fairer.
segments.tr: Eso hace que las comparaciones mes a mes sean más justas.

segments.src: Unadjusted figures show the raw totals.
segments.tr: Las cifras sin ajustar muestran los totales brutos.

segments.src: Remember that prices are not removed.** Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars.
segments.tr: Recuerda que los precios no se eliminan.** Las ventas minoristas se informan en dólares nominales.

segments.src: If prices rise 0.3% in a month, sales can grow 0.2% while the actual quantity of goods bought falls slightly.
segments.tr: Si los precios suben un 0.3% en un mes, las ventas pueden crecer un 0.2% mientras que la cantidad real de bienes comprados cae ligeramente.

segments.src: Comparing the sales figure with inflation data gives a better picture of real demand.
segments.tr: Comparar la cifra de ventas con los datos de inflación ofrece una mejor imagen de la demanda real.

segments.src: Expect revisions.** The first estimate is an "advance" reading based on a sample of businesses.
segments.tr: Espera revisiones.** La primera estimación es una lectura "preliminar" basada en una muestra de empresas.

segments.src: It is often revised in later releases, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: A menudo se revisa en publicaciones posteriores, a veces de manera significativa.

segments.src: A 0.2% reading could later be adjusted up or down, and the prior month's number can change too.
segments.tr: Una lectura del 0.2% podría ajustarse más tarde hacia arriba o hacia abajo, y el número del mes anterior también puede cambiar.

segments.src: Look beneath the top line.** The report breaks sales into categories, including motor vehicles, building materials, grocery stores, restaurants, clothing, electronics and online retail.
segments.tr: Mira más allá de la línea principal.** El informe divide las ventas en categorías, incluidos vehículos de motor, materiales de construcción, tiendas de comestibles, restaurantes, ropa, electrónica y comercio minorista en línea.

segments.src: Many analysts also look at a narrower measure that excludes autos and gasoline, since those two categories can swing sharply with prices and supply and may obscure underlying trends.
segments.tr: Muchos analistas también observan una medida más estrecha que excluye autos y gasolina, ya que esas dos categorías pueden oscilar fuertemente con los precios y la oferta y pueden oscurecer las tendencias subyacentes.

segments.src: Compare against expectations.** Markets and commentators react less to the raw figure than to how it compares with forecasts.
segments.tr: Compara con las expectativas.** Los mercados y los comentaristas reaccionan menos a la cifra bruta que a cómo se compara con los pronósticos.

segments.src: A result in line with consensus, as in October, usually signals continuity rather than a turning point.
segments.tr: Un resultado en línea con el consenso, como en octubre, suele indicar continuidad en lugar de un punto de inflexión.

segments.src: ## Why gasoline can crowd out other spending
segments.tr: ## Por qué la gasolina puede desplazar otros gastos

segments.src: Gas stations count as retail sales, so higher pump prices can lift the headline number even when people are not buying more of anything.
segments.tr: Las gasolineras cuentan como ventas minoristas, por lo que unos precios más altos en el surtidor pueden elevar la cifra principal incluso cuando la gente no esté comprando más de nada.

segments.src: Households do not have unlimited budgets, though.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, los hogares no tienen presupuestos ilimitados.

segments.src: When a bigger share of income goes to fuel, there is less left for discretionary items like clothing, electronics, dining out and gifts.
segments.tr: Cuando una mayor proporción de los ingresos se destina al combustible, queda menos para artículos discrecionales como ropa, electrónica, salir a cenar y regalos.

segments.src: That effect works in two directions:
segments.tr: Ese efecto funciona en dos direcciones:

segments.src: - **Headline versus underlying strength.** A rise in fuel prices can make total sales look healthier than the rest of the economy actually is. Falling fuel prices can do the opposite, dragging down the total while leaving more money in household budgets for other purchases.
segments.tr: - **Titulares frente a la solidez subyacente.** Un aumento en los precios del combustible puede hacer que las ventas totales parezcan más saludables de lo que el resto de la economía realmente está. La caída de los precios del combustible puede hacer lo contrario, arrastrando el total mientras deja más dinero en los presupuestos de los hogares para otras compras.

segments.src: - **Squeezed budgets.** Gas is a necessity for most commuters. When it costs more, many families cut elsewhere, often on non-essential categories first. Lower-income households, which spend a larger share of income on fuel and other basics, tend to feel this most.
segments.tr: - **Presupuestos presionados.** La gasolina es una necesidad para la mayoría de los viajeros diarios. Cuando cuesta más, muchas familias recortan en otros aspectos, a menudo en categorías no esenciales primero. Los hogares de lower-income, que gastan una mayor proporción de sus ingresos en combustible y otros productos básicos, tienden a sentir esto más.

segments.src: This is why economists look at the "control group" and ex-gasoline measures as well as the total.
segments.tr: Por esto es por lo que los economistas observan el "grupo de control" y las medidas excluyendo la gasolina, así como el total.

segments.src: They help separate real changes in shopping behavior from price movements in a single category.
segments.tr: Ayudan a separar los cambios reales en el comportamiento de compra de los movimientos de precios en una sola categoría.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for holiday sales
segments.tr: ## Qué podría significar para las ventas navideñas

segments.src: It is tempting to treat one month of data as a forecast for November and December.
segments.tr: Es tentador tratar un mes de datos como un pronóstico para noviembre y diciembre.

segments.src: That would overreach.
segments.tr: Eso sería exagerar.

segments.src: Still, a few points are reasonable.
segments.tr: Aun así, algunos puntos son razonables.

segments.src: **Steady, not spectacular.** A modest gain suggests consumers are still spending but are more selective.
segments.tr: **Estables, no espectaculares.** Una ganancia moderada sugiere que los consumidores siguen gastando pero son más selectivos.

segments.src: Retailers may see a season that grows at a moderate pace rather than one driven by a rush of impulse buying.
segments.tr: Los minoristas pueden ver una temporada que crece a un ritmo moderado en lugar de una impulsada por una avalancha de compras por impulso.

segments.src: **Promotions matter.** When shoppers are cautious, discounts and early sales events tend to carry more weight.
segments.tr: **Las promociones importan.** Cuando los compradores son cautelosos, los descuentos y los eventos de ventas anticipadas tienden a tener más peso.

segments.src: Many retailers already start holiday promotions in October, which may pull some demand forward and affect how monthly numbers look.
segments.tr: Muchos minoristas ya comienzan las promociones navideñas en octubre, lo que puede adelantar cierta demanda y afectar cómo se ven los números mensuales.

segments.src: **Online keeps gaining share.** Over the long run, e-commerce has taken a growing portion of retail spending.
segments.tr: **El comercio en línea sigue ganando terreno.** A largo plazo, el comercio electrónico ha tomado una porción creciente del gasto minorista.

segments.src: Holiday results for physical stores and online sellers often diverge, so category detail is worth watching.
segments.tr: Los resultados navideños para las tiendas físicas y los vendedores en línea a menudo divergen, por lo que vale la pena vigilar el detalle por categorías.

segments.src: **The big drivers are still ahead.** Employment, wage growth, borrowing costs and consumer confidence will shape the rest of the season.
segments.tr: **Los grandes impulsores aún están por delante.** El empleo, el crecimiento salarial, los costos de endeudamiento y la confianza del consumidor darán forma al resto de la temporada.

segments.src: So will weather, shipping capacity and the timing of major sales days.
segments.tr: También lo harán el clima, la capacidad de envío y el momento de los principales días de rebajas.

segments.src: No single data point settles the outcome.
segments.tr: Ningún punto de datos por sí solo determina el resultado.

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Conclusiones prácticas para los compradores

segments.src: If you are planning your own holiday budget, the broader story is less important than your own finances.
segments.tr: Si estás planeando tu propio presupuesto navideño, la historia general es menos importante que tus propias finanzas.

segments.src: A few simple steps can help:
segments.tr: Unos sencillos pasos pueden ayudar:

segments.src: - Set a total spending limit before shopping starts, and divide it among gifts, travel and food.
segments.tr: - Establece un límite de gasto total antes de empezar a comprar, y divídelo entre regalos, viajes y comida.

segments.src: - Compare prices across several retailers, and check return policies.
segments.tr: - Compara precios en varios minoristas y revisa las políticas de devolución.

segments.src: - Be wary of "limited time" pressure. A real bargain will usually still be a bargain tomorrow.
segments.tr: - Desconfía de la presión de "tiempo limitado". Una verdadera ganga por lo general seguirá siendo una ganga mañana.

segments.src: - Try to avoid putting purchases on credit cards you cannot pay off promptly, since interest can erase any savings from a sale.
segments.tr: - Intenta evitar hacer compras con tarjetas de crédito que no puedas pagar puntualmente, ya que los intereses pueden borrar cualquier ahorro de una oferta.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: October's 0.2% increase shows a consumer who is still spending but at a calmer pace after September's burst.
segments.tr: El aumento del 0.2% en octubre muestra a un consumidor que sigue gastando pero a un ritmo más tranquilo tras el estallido de septiembre.

segments.src: Because the result matched expectations, it is best read as a sign of continuity.
segments.tr: Debido a que el resultado coincidió con las expectativas, se lee mejor como una señal de continuidad.

segments.src: For the holidays, the more useful questions are how much of the gain came from price changes rather than real purchases, how households are handling fuel and other living costs, and what the next reports show.
segments.tr: Para las fiestas, las preguntas más útiles son cuánto de la ganancia provino de cambios de precios en lugar de compras reales, cómo están manejando los hogares el combustible y otros costos de vida, y qué muestran los próximos informes.

segments.src: Revisions and new data in the coming weeks will provide a clearer picture.
segments.tr: Las revisiones y los nuevos datos en las próximas semanas proporcionarán una imagen más clara.

segments.src: ## How to read a Census Bureau retail report
segments.tr: ## كيفية قراءة تقرير التجزئة الصادر عن مكتب الإحصاء

segments.src: A single headline number hides a lot.
segments.tr: رقم رئيسي واحد يخفي الكثير.

segments.src: A few habits help when you read the release.
segments.tr: تساعدك بعض العادات عند قراءة الإصدار.

segments.src: Check whether the figures are adjusted.** The headline number is usually seasonally adjusted, which smooths out predictable patterns such as holiday spikes and summer travel.
segments.tr: تحقق مما إذا كانت الأرقام معدلة.** عادة ما يكون الرقم الرئيسي معدلاً موسمياً، مما يمهد الأنماط المتوقعة مثل ارتفاعات العطلات والسفر الصيفي.

segments.src: That makes month-to-month comparisons fairer.
segments.tr: هذا يجعل المقارنات من شهر لآخر أكثر عدالة.

segments.src: Unadjusted figures show the raw totals.
segments.tr: تظهر الأرقام غير المعدلة الإجماليات الخام.

segments.src: Remember that prices are not removed.** Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars.
segments.tr: تذكر أنه لم يتم استبعاد الأسعار.** يتم الإبلاغ عن مبيعات التجزئة بالدولار الاسمي.

segments.src: If prices rise 0.3% in a month, sales can grow 0.2% while the actual quantity of goods bought falls slightly.
segments.tr: إذا ارتفعت الأسعار بنسبة 0.3% في شهر ما، يمكن أن تنمو المبيعات بنسبة 0.2% بينما تنخفض الكمية الفعلية للبضائع المشتراة قليلاً.

segments.src: Comparing the sales figure with inflation data gives a better picture of real demand.
segments.tr: مقارنة رقم المبيعات مع بيانات التضخم تعطي صورة أفضل للطلب الحقيقي.

segments.src: Expect revisions.** The first estimate is an "advance" reading based on a sample of businesses.
segments.tr: توقع التعديلات.** التقدير الأول هو قراءة "أولية" تستند إلى عينة من الشركات.

segments.src: It is often revised in later releases, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يتم تعديله في الإصدارات اللاحقة، وأحياناً بشكل ملموس.

segments.src: A 0.2% reading could later be adjusted up or down, and the prior month's number can change too.
segments.tr: يمكن تعديل قراءة 0.2% لاحقاً إلى الأعلى أو الأسفل، كما يمكن أن يتغير رقم الشهر السابق أيضاً.

segments.src: Look beneath the top line.** The report breaks sales into categories, including motor vehicles, building materials, grocery stores, restaurants, clothing, electronics and online retail.
segments.tr: انظر إلى ما وراء السطر الرئيسي.** يقسم التقرير المبيعات إلى فئات، بما في ذلك السيارات، ومواد البناء، ومتاجر البقالة، والمطاعم، والملابس، والإلكترونيات، والتجزئة عبر الإنترنت.

segments.src: Many analysts also look at a narrower measure that excludes autos and gasoline, since those two categories can swing sharply with prices and supply and may obscure underlying trends.
segments.tr: ينظر العديد من المحللين أيضاً إلى مقياس أضيق يستثني السيارات والبنزين، حيث يمكن لهاتين الفئتين أن تتأرجحا بشدة مع الأسعار والإمدادات وقد تحجبان الاتجاهات الأساسية.

segments.src: Compare against expectations.** Markets and commentators react less to the raw figure than to how it compares with forecasts.
segments.tr: قارن مقابل التوقعات.** تتفاعل الأسواق والمعلقون بشكل أقل مع الرقم الخام مقارنة بكيفية مقارنته بالتوقعات.

segments.src: A result in line with consensus, as in October, usually signals continuity rather than a turning point.
segments.tr: النتيجة التي تتماشى مع الإجماع، كما في أكتوبر، تشير عادةً إلى الاستمرارية بدلاً من نقطة تحول.

segments.src: ## Why gasoline can crowd out other spending
segments.tr: ## لماذا يمكن للبنزين أن يزاحم الإنفاق الآخر

segments.src: Gas stations count as retail sales, so higher pump prices can lift the headline number even when people are not buying more of anything.
segments.tr: تُحتسب محطات الوقود ضمن مبيعات التجزئة، لذا يمكن لأسعار المضخات المرتفعة أن ترفع الرقم الرئيسي حتى عندما لا يشتري الناس المزيد من أي شيء آخر.

segments.src: Households do not have unlimited budgets, though.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، لا تملك الأسر ميزانيات غير محدودة.

segments.src: When a bigger share of income goes to fuel, there is less left for discretionary items like clothing, electronics, dining out and gifts.
segments.tr: عندما تذهب حصة أكبر من الدخل إلى الوقود، يتبقى قدر أقل للمواد الاختيارية مثل الملابس والإلكترونيات وتناول الطعام في الخارج والهدايا.

segments.src: That effect works in two directions:
segments.tr: هذا التأثير يعمل في اتجاهين:

segments.src: - **Headline versus underlying strength.** A rise in fuel prices can make total sales look healthier than the rest of the economy actually is. Falling fuel prices can do the opposite, dragging down the total while leaving more money in household budgets for other purchases.
segments.tr: - **القوة الرئيسية مقابل القوة الأساسية.** يمكن أن يجعل ارتفاع أسعار الوقود إجمالي المبيعات يبدو أكثر صحة مما هو عليه بقية الاقتصاد في الواقع. وتراجع أسعار الوقود يمكن أن يفعل العكس، حيث يسحب الإجمالي إلى الأسفل بينما يترك المزيد من المال في ميزانيات الأسر لمشتريات أخرى.

segments.src: - **Squeezed budgets.** Gas is a necessity for most commuters. When it costs more, many families cut elsewhere, often on non-essential categories first. Lower-income households, which spend a larger share of income on fuel and other basics, tend to feel this most.
segments.tr: - **الميزانيات المضغوطة.** البنزين ضرورة لمعظم المتنقلين للعمل. عندما يكلف أكثر، تقطع العديد من العائلات النفقات في أماكن أخرى، وغالباً ما تكون الفئات غير الضرورية أولاً. وتميل الأسر ذات الدخل المنخفض، التي تنفق حصة أكبر من دخلها على الوقود والأساسيات الأخرى، إلى الشعور بهذا أكثر من غيرها.

segments.src: This is why economists look at the "control group" and ex-gasoline measures as well as the total.
segments.tr: لهذا السبب ينظر الاقتصاديو إلى "المجموعة الضابطة" ومقاييس استبعاد البنزين بالإضافة إلى الإجمالي.

segments.src: They help separate real changes in shopping behavior from price movements in a single category.
segments.tr: إنها تساعد في فصل التغيرات الحقيقية في سلوك التسوق عن تحركات الأسعار في فئة واحدة.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for holiday sales
segments.tr: ## ماذا قد يعني ذلك لمبيعات العطلات

segments.src: It is tempting to treat one month of data as a forecast for November and December.
segments.tr: من المغري التعامل مع شهر واحد من البيانات كتوقع لشهري نوفمبر وديسمبر.

segments.src: That would overreach.
segments.tr: سيكون ذلك مبالغاً فيه.

segments.src: Still, a few points are reasonable.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن بضع نقاط تبدو معقولة.

segments.src: **Steady, not spectacular.** A modest gain suggests consumers are still spending but are more selective.
segments.tr: **ثابت، وليس مبهراً.** يشير المكسب المتواضع إلى أن المستهلكين يواصلون الإنفاق ولكنهم أكثر انتقائية.

segments.src: Retailers may see a season that grows at a moderate pace rather than one driven by a rush of impulse buying.
segments.tr: قد يرى تجار التجزئة موسماً ينمو بوعاء معتدل بدلاً من موسم مدفوع باندفاع الشراء العفوي.

segments.src: **Promotions matter.** When shoppers are cautious, discounts and early sales events tend to carry more weight.
segments.tr: **العروض الترويجية تهم.** عندما يكون المتسوقون حذرين، تميل الخصومات وأحداث المبيعات المبكرة إلى حمل وزن أكبر.

segments.src: Many retailers already start holiday promotions in October, which may pull some demand forward and affect how monthly numbers look.
segments.tr: بدأ العديد من تجار التجزئة بالفعل العروض الترويجية للعطلات في أكتوبر، مما قد يسحب بعض الطلب إلى الأمام ويؤثر على كيفية ظهور الأرقام الشهرية.

segments.src: **Online keeps gaining share.** Over the long run, e-commerce has taken a growing portion of retail spending.
segments.tr: **التجارة عبر الإنترنت تواصل كسب الحصة.** على المدى الطويل، أخذت التجارة الإلكترونية حصة متزايدة من إنفاق التجزئة.

segments.src: Holiday results for physical stores and online sellers often diverge, so category detail is worth watching.
segments.tr: غالباً ما تتباعد نتائج العطلات للمتاجر الفعلية والبائعين عبر الإنترنت، لذا تسترعي تفاصيل الفئات المتابعة.

segments.src: **The big drivers are still ahead.** Employment, wage growth, borrowing costs and consumer confidence will shape the rest of the season.
segments.tr: **المحركات الكبيرة لا تزال أمامنا.** التوظيف، ونمو الأجور، وتكاليف الاقتراض، وثقة المستهلك ستشكل بقية الموسم.

segments.src: So will weather, shipping capacity and the timing of major sales days.
segments.tr: وكذلك الطقس، وسعة الشحن، وتوقيت أيام المبيعات الكبرى.

segments.src: No single data point settles the outcome.
segments.tr: لا توجد نقطة بيانات واحدة تحسم النتيجة.

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for shoppers
segments.tr: **نصائح عملية للمتسوقين**

segments.src: If you are planning your own holiday budget, the broader story is less important than your own finances.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تخطط لميزانية العطلات الخاصة بك، فإن القصة الأوسع أقل أهمية من أموالك الخاصة.

segments.src: A few simple steps can help:
segments.tr: يمكن لبضع خطوات بسيطة أن تساعد:

segments.src: - Set a total spending limit before shopping starts, and divide it among gifts, travel and food.
segments.tr: - حدد حدا أقصى للإنفاق الإجمالي قبل بدء التسوق، وقسمه بين الهدايا والسفر والطعام.

segments.src: - Compare prices across several retailers, and check return policies.
segments.tr: - قارن الأسعار عبر العديد من تجار التجزئة، وتحقق من سياسات الإرجاع.

segments.src: - Be wary of "limited time" pressure. A real bargain will usually still be a bargain tomorrow.
segments.tr: - حذر من ضغط "الوقت المحدود". فالصفقة الحقيقية ستظل عادة صفقة غداً.

segments.src: - Try to avoid putting purchases on credit cards you cannot pay off promptly, since interest can erase any savings from a sale.
segments.tr: - حاول تجنب وضع المشتريات على بطاقات الائتمان التي لا يمكنك سدادها على الفور، حيث يمكن للفوائد أن تمحو أي مدخرات من الخصم.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: October's 0.2% increase shows a consumer who is still spending but at a calmer pace after September's burst.
segments.tr: تظهر زيادة أكتوبر بنسبة 0.2% مستهلكاً يواصل الإنفاق ولكن بوتيرة أكثر هدوءاً بعد اندفاعة سبتمبر.

segments.src: Because the result matched expectations, it is best read as a sign of continuity.
segments.tr: نظراً لأن النتيجة طابقت التوقعات، فمن الأفضل قراءتها كعلامة على الاستمرارية.

segments.src: For the holidays, the more useful questions are how much of the gain came from price changes rather than real purchases, how households are handling fuel and other living costs, and what the next reports show.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للعطلات، فإن الأسئلة الأكثر فائدة هي كم من المكسب جاء من التغيرات في الأسعار بدلاً من المشتريات الحقيقية، وكيف تتعامل الأسر مع الوقود وتكاليف المعيشة الأخرى، وما تظهره التقارير القادمة.

segments.src: Revisions and new data in the coming weeks will provide a clearer picture.
segments.tr: ستوفر التعديلات والبيانات الجديدة في الأسابيع القادمة صورة أكثر وضوحاً.

fr.title: Les consommateurs ralentissent : ce qu'une hausse des ventes au détail de 0,2 % en octobre révèle sur la saison des fêtes

segments.src: After a strong September, American shoppers eased off the gas in October.
segments.tr: Après un mois de septembre solide, les acheteurs américains ont levé le pied en octobre.

segments.src: Retail sales rose 0.2% for the month, according to the Census Bureau's advance estimate, following a 0.8% jump in September.
segments.tr: Les ventes au détail ont augmenté de 0,2 % pour le mois, selon l'estimation provisoire du Bureau du recensement, après un bond de 0,8 % en septembre.

segments.src: The October figure matched what forecasters had expected, so it was not a surprise.
segments.tr: Le chiffre d'octobre a correspondu aux attentes des prévisionnistes, ce n'était donc pas une surprise.

segments.src: It still gives us a useful chance to look at how consumers are behaving heading into the busiest shopping stretch of the year.

segments.tr: - **Chiffre principal par rapport à la force sous-jacente.** Une hausse des prix du carburant peut donner l'impression que les ventes totales sont plus saines qu'elles ne le sont réellement dans le reste de l'économie. La baisse des prix du carburant peut faire le contraire, en tirant le total vers le bas tout en laissant plus d'argent dans les budgets des ménages pour d'autres achats.

segments.src: - **Squeezed budgets.** Gas is a necessity for most commuters. When it costs more, many families cut elsewhere, often on non-essential categories first. Lower-income households, which spend a larger share of income on fuel and other basics, tend to feel this most.
segments.tr: - **Budgets serrés.** L'essence est une nécessité pour la plupart des navetteurs. Lorsqu'elle coûte plus cher, de nombreuses familles réduisent leurs dépenses ailleurs, souvent d'abord dans les catégories non essentielles. Les ménages à faible revenu, qui consacrent une plus grande part de leur revenu au carburant et à d'autres produits de première nécessité, ont tendance à ressentir cela le plus.

segments.src: This is why economists look at the "control group" and ex-gasoline measures as well as the total.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi les économistes examinent le « groupe de contrôle » et les mesures hors essence ainsi que le total.

segments.src: They help separate real changes in shopping behavior from price movements in a single category.
segments.tr: Ils aident à séparer les changements réels dans le comportement d'achat des mouvements de prix dans une seule catégorie.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for holiday sales

segments.tr: Il est tentant de traiter un mois de données comme une prévision pour novembre et décembre.

segments.tr: Ce serait aller trop loin.

segments.tr: **Stable, pas spectaculaire.** Une hausse modeste suggère que les consommateurs continuent de dépenser mais sont plus sélectifs.

segments.src: **Promotions matter.** When shoppers are cautious, discounts and early sales events tend to carry more weight.
segments.tr: **Les promotions comptent.** Lorsque les acheteurs sont prudents, les remises et les événements de vente anticipés ont tendance à peser plus lourd.

segments.src: Many retailers already start holiday promotions in October, which may pull some demand forward and affect how monthly numbers look.

segments.src: **Online keeps gaining share.** Over the long run, e-commerce has taken a growing portion of retail spending.

segments.src: Holiday results for physical stores and online sellers often diverge, so category detail is worth watching.

segments.src: **The big drivers are still ahead.** Employment, wage growth, borrowing costs and consumer confidence will shape the rest of the season.
segments.tr: **Les grands moteurs sont encore à venir.** L'emploi, la croissance des salaires, les coûts d'emprunt et la confiance des consommateurs façonneront le reste de la saison.

segments.tr: O relatório mensal é um dos indicadores mais acompanhados da demanda do consumidor.

segments.src: Consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.

segments.src: economic activity, so shifts in shopping habits matter well beyond store aisles.

segments.src: ## How to read a Census Bureau retail report
segments.tr: ## Como ler um relatório de varejo do Census Bureau

segments.src: A single headline number hides a lot.
segments.tr: Um único número principal esconde muita coisa.

segments.src: A few habits help when you read the release.
segments.tr: Alguns hábitos ajudam na hora de ler a divulgação.

segments.src: Check whether the figures are adjusted.** The headline number is usually seasonally adjusted, which smooths out predictable patterns such as holiday spikes and summer travel.
segments.tr: Verifique se os números são ajustados.** O número principal geralmente é ajustado sazonalmente, o que suaviza padrões previsíveis, como picos de fim de ano e viagens de verão.

segments.src: That makes month-to-month comparisons fairer.
segments.tr: Isso torna as comparações mês a mês mais justas.

segments.src: Unadjusted figures show the raw totals.
segments.tr: Os dados não ajustados mostram os totais brutos.

segments.src: Remember that prices are not removed.** Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars.
segments.tr: Lembre-se de que os preços não são removidos.** As vendas no varejo são reportadas em dólares nominais.

segments.src: If prices rise 0.3% in a month, sales can grow 0.2% while the actual quantity of goods bought falls slightly.
segments.tr: Se os preços sobem 0,3% em um mês, as vendas podem crescer 0,2% enquanto a quantidade real de bens comprados cai ligeiramente.

segments.src: Comparing the sales figure with inflation data gives a better picture of real demand.
segments.tr: Comparar o dado de vendas com os dados de inflação dá um panorama melhor da demanda real.

segments.src: Expect revisions.** The first estimate is an "advance" reading based on a sample of businesses.
segments.tr: Espere revisões.** A primeira estimativa é uma leitura "preliminar" baseada em uma amostra de empresas.

segments.src: It is often revised in later releases, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: Ela frequentemente é revisada em divulgações posteriores, às vezes de forma significativa.

segments.src: A 0.2% reading could later be adjusted up or down, and the prior month's number can change too.
segments.tr: Uma leitura de 0,2% pode ser ajustada para cima ou para baixo posteriormente, e o número do mês anterior também pode mudar.

segments.src: Look beneath the top line.** The report breaks sales into categories, including motor vehicles, building materials, grocery stores, restaurants, clothing, electronics and online retail.
segments.tr: Olhe além do topo.** O relatório divide as vendas em categorias, incluindo veículos motorizados, materiais de construção, supermercados, restaurantes, vestuário, eletrônicos e varejo online.

segments.src: Many analysts also look at a narrower measure that excludes autos and gasoline, since those two categories can swing sharply with prices and supply and may obscure underlying trends.
segments.tr: Muitos analistas também olham para uma medida mais restrita que exclui automóveis e gasolina, já que essas duas categorias podem oscilar fortemente com os preços e a oferta e podem obscurecer tendências subjacentes.

segments.src: Compare against expectations.** Markets and commentators react less to the raw figure than to how it compares with forecasts.
segments.tr: Compare com as expectativas.** Os mercados e comentaristas reagem menos ao dado bruto do que a como ele se compara com as previsões.

segments.src: A result in line with consensus, as in October, usually signals continuity rather than a turning point.
segments.tr: Um resultado em linha com o consenso, como em outubro, geralmente sinaliza continuidade em vez de um ponto de virada.

segments.src: ## Why gasoline can crowd out other spending
segments.tr: ## Por que a gasolina pode espremer outros gastos

segments.src: Gas stations count as retail sales, so higher pump prices can lift the headline number even when people are not buying more of anything.
segments.tr: Os postos de gasolina contam como vendas no varejo, portanto preços mais altos nas bombas podem elevar o número principal mesmo quando as pessoas não estão comprando mais nada.

segments.src: Households do not have unlimited budgets, though.
segments.tr: As famílias não têm orçamentos ilimitados, no entanto.

segments.src: When a bigger share of income goes to fuel, there is less left for discretionary items like clothing, electronics, dining out and gifts.
segments.tr: Quando uma fatia maior da renda vai para combustível, sobra menos para itens discricionários como roupas, eletrônicos, comer fora e presentes.

segments.src: - **Squeezed budgets.** Gas is a necessity for most commuters. When it costs more, many families cut elsewhere, often on non-essential categories first. Lower-income households, which spend a larger share of income on fuel and other basics, tend to feel this most.

Quando custa mais, muitas famílias cortam gastos em outros lugares, frequentemente em categorias não essenciais primeiro. As famílias de menor renda, que gastam uma parcela maior da renda em combustível e outros itens básicos, tendem a sentir isso mais.

segments.tr: Ingatlah bahwa harga tidak dihilangkan.** Penjualan ritel dilaporkan dalam dolar nominal.

segments.src: If prices rise 0.3% in a month, sales can grow 0.2% while the actual quantity of goods bought falls slightly.
segments.tr: Jika harga naik 0,3% dalam sebulan, penjualan dapat tumbuh 0,2% sementara jumlah aktual barang yang dibeli sedikit turun.

segments.src: Comparing the sales figure with inflation data gives a better picture of real demand.
segments.tr: Membandingkan angka penjualan dengan data inflasi memberikan gambaran yang lebih baik tentang permintaan riil.

segments.src: Expect revisions.** The first estimate is an "advance" reading based on a sample of businesses.
segments.tr: Harapkan revisi.** Estimasi pertama adalah pembacaan "awal" berdasarkan sampel bisnis.

segments.src: It is often revised in later releases, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: Ini sering direvisi dalam rilis selanjutnya, terkadang secara signifikan.

segments.src: A 0.2% reading could later be adjusted up or down, and the prior month's number can change too.
segments.tr: Pembacaan 0,2% kemudian dapat disesuaikan naik atau turun, dan angka bulan sebelumnya juga dapat berubah.

segments.src: Look beneath the top line.** The report breaks sales into categories, including motor vehicles, building materials, grocery stores, restaurants, clothing, electronics and online retail.
segments.tr: Lihat di bawah garis atas.** Laporan tersebut memecah penjualan ke dalam kategori, termasuk kendaraan bermotor, bahan bangunan, toko kelontong, restoran, pakaian, elektronik, dan ritel online.

segments.src: Many analysts also look at a narrower measure that excludes autos and gasoline, since those two categories can swing sharply with prices and supply and may obscure underlying trends.
segments.tr: Banyak analis juga melihat ukuran yang lebih sempit yang mengecualikan mobil dan bensin, karena kedua kategori tersebut dapat berfluktuasi tajam dengan harga dan pasokan serta dapat mengaburkan tren mendasar.

segments.src: Compare against expectations.** Markets and commentators react less to the raw figure than to how it compares with forecasts.
segments.tr: Bandingkan dengan ekspektasi.** Pasar dan komentator bereaksi lebih sedikit terhadap angka mentah daripada bagaimana itu dibandingkan dengan perkiraan.

segments.src: A result in line with consensus, as in October, usually signals continuity rather than a turning point.
segments.tr: Hasil sejalan dengan konsensus, seperti pada bulan Oktober, biasanya menandakan kelanjutan alih-alih titik balik.

segments.src: ## Why gasoline can crowd out other spending
segments.tr: ## Mengapa bensin dapat mendesak pengeluaran lainnya

segments.src: Gas stations count as retail sales, so higher pump prices can lift the headline number even when people are not buying more of anything.
segments.tr: Pompa bensin dihitung sebagai penjualan ritel, sehingga harga pompa yang lebih tinggi dapat mengangkat angka utama bahkan ketika orang tidak membeli lebih banyak dari apa pun.

segments.src: Households do not have unlimited budgets, though.
segments.tr: Namun, rumah tangga tidak memiliki anggaran tak terbatas.

segments.src: When a bigger share of income goes to fuel, there is less left for discretionary items like clothing, electronics, dining out and gifts.
segments.tr: Ketika porsi pendapatan yang lebih besar masuk ke bahan bakar, lebih sedikit yang tersisa untuk barang-barang diskresioner seperti pakaian, elektronik, makan di luar, dan hadiah.

segments.src: That effect works in two directions:
segments.tr: Efek itu bekerja ke dua arah:

segments.src: - **Headline versus underlying strength.** A rise in fuel prices can make total sales look healthier than the rest of the economy actually is. Falling fuel prices can do the opposite, dragging down the total while leaving more money in household budgets for other purchases.
segments.tr: - **Kekuatan utama versus mendasar.** Kenaikan harga bahan bakar dapat membuat total penjualan terlihat lebih sehat daripada ekonomi lainnya yang sebenarnya. Penurunan harga bahan bakar dapat melakukan sebaliknya, menyeret total ke bawah sambil menyisakan lebih banyak uang dalam anggaran rumah tangga untuk pembelian lainnya.

segments.src: - **Squeezed budgets.** Gas is a necessity for most commuters. When it costs more, many families cut elsewhere, often on non-essential categories first. Lower-income households, which spend a larger share of income on fuel and other basics, tend to feel this most.
segments.tr: - **Anggaran tertekan.** Bensin adalah kebutuhan bagi sebagian besar pebisnis. Ketika biayanya lebih mahal, banyak keluarga memotong di tempat lain, seringkali pada kategori non-esensial terlebih dahulu. Rumah tangga berpenghasilan rendah, yang menghabiskan sebagian besar pendapatan mereka untuk bahan bakar dan kebutuhan pokok lainnya, cenderung paling merasakannya.

segments.src: This is why economists look at the "control group" and ex-gasoline measures as well as the total.
segments.tr: Inilah sebabnya mengapa para ekonom melihat "kelompok kontrol" dan ukuran non-bensin serta totalnya.

segments.src: They help separate real changes in shopping behavior from price movements in a single category.
segments.tr: Mereka membantu memisahkan perubahan nyata dalam perilaku berbelanja dari pergerakan harga dalam satu kategori.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for holiday sales
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi penjualan liburan

segments.src: It is tempting to treat one month of data as a forecast for November and December.
segments.tr: Sangat menggoda untuk memperlakukan satu bulan data sebagai prakiraan untuk November dan Desember.

segments.src: That would overreach.
segments.tr: Itu akan terlalu jauh.

segments.src: Still, a few points are reasonable.
segments.tr: Namun, beberapa poin masuk akal.

segments.src: **Steady, not spectacular.** A modest gain suggests consumers are still spending but are more selective.
segments.tr: **Stabil, bukan spektakuler.** Kenaikan sederhana menunjukkan konsumen masih membelanjakan uang tetapi lebih selektif.

segments.src: Retailers may see a season that grows at a moderate pace rather than one driven by a rush of impulse buying.
segments.tr: Pengecer mungkin melihat musim yang tumbuh pada kecepatan moderat daripada yang didorong oleh terburu-buru pembelian impulsif.

segments.src: **Promotions matter.** When shoppers are cautious, discounts and early sales events tend to carry more weight.
segments.tr: **Promosi penting.** Ketika pembeli berhati-hati, diskon dan acara penjualan awal cenderung memiliki bobot lebih.

segments.src: Many retailers already start holiday promotions in October, which may pull some demand forward and affect how monthly numbers look.
segments.tr: Banyak pengecer sudah memulai promosi liburan di bulan Oktober, yang dapat menarik beberapa permintaan ke depan dan memengaruhi bagaimana angka bulanan terlihat.

segments.src: **Online keeps gaining share.** Over the long run, e-commerce has taken a growing portion of retail spending.
segments.tr: **Online terus mendapatkan pangsa.** Dalam jangka panjang, e-commerce telah mengambil porsi pengeluaran ritel yang semakin besar.

segments.src: Holiday results for physical stores and online sellers often diverge, so category detail is worth watching.
segments.tr: Hasil liburan untuk toko fisik dan penjual online sering kali menyimpang, sehingga detail kategori layak untuk ditonton.

segments.src: **The big drivers are still ahead.** Employment, wage growth, borrowing costs and consumer confidence will shape the rest of the season.
segments.tr: **Pendorong besar masih di depan.** Lapangan kerja, pertumbuhan upah, biaya pinjaman, dan kepercayaan konsumen akan membentuk sisa musim ini.

segments.src: So will weather, shipping capacity and the timing of major sales days.
segments.tr: Begitu juga cuaca, kapasitas pengiriman, dan waktu hari-hari penjualan utama.

segments.src: No single data point settles the outcome.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu titik data pun yang menyelesaikan hasilnya.

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Pengambilan praktis untuk pembeli

segments.src: If you are planning your own holiday budget, the broader story is less important than your own finances.
segments.tr: Jika Anda merencanakan anggaran liburan Anda sendiri, kisah yang lebih luas kurang penting daripada keuangan Anda sendiri.

segments.src: A few simple steps can help:
segments.tr: Beberapa langkah sederhana dapat membantu:

segments.src: - Set a total spending limit before shopping starts, and divide it among gifts, travel and food.
segments.tr: - Tetapkan batas pengeluaran total sebelum belanja dimulai, dan bagi di antara hadiah, perjalanan, dan makanan.

segments.src: - Compare prices across several retailers, and check return policies.
segments.tr: - Bandingkan harga di beberapa pengecer, dan periksa kebijakan pengembalian.

segments.src: - Be wary of "limited time" pressure. A real bargain will usually still be a bargain tomorrow.
segments.tr: - Waspadai tekanan "waktu terbatas". Tawar-menawar nyata biasanya masih akan menjadi tawar-menawar besok.

segments.src: - Try to avoid putting purchases on credit cards you cannot pay off promptly, since interest can erase any savings from a sale.
segments.tr: - Cobalah untuk menghindari menempatkan pembelian pada kartu kredit yang tidak dapat Anda lunasi dengan segera, karena bunga dapat menghapus penghematan apa pun dari obral.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: October's 0.2% increase shows a consumer who is still spending but at a calmer pace after September's burst.
segments.tr: Kenaikan 0,2% bulan Oktober menunjukkan konsumen yang masih membelanjakan uang tetapi dengan kecepatan yang lebih tenang setelah ledakan bulan September.

segments.src: Because the result matched expectations, it is best read as a sign of continuity.
segments.tr: Karena hasilnya cocok dengan ekspektasi, paling baik dibaca sebagai tanda kelanjutan.

segments.src: For the holidays, the more useful questions are how much of the gain came from price changes rather than real purchases, how households are handling fuel and other living costs, and what the next reports show.
segments.tr: Untuk liburan, pertanyaan yang lebih berguna adalah berapa banyak kenaikan yang berasal dari perubahan harga daripada pembelian riil, bagaimana rumah tangga menangani bahan bakar dan biaya hidup lainnya, dan apa yang ditunjukkan oleh laporan berikutnya.

segments.src: Revisions and new data in the coming weeks will provide a clearer picture.
segments.tr: Revisi dan data baru dalam beberapa minggu mendatang akan memberikan gambaran yang lebih jelas.

de.title: Käufer treten auf die Bremse: Was ein Anstieg der Einzelhandelsumsätze im Oktober um 0,2% über die Feiertagssaison aussagt

segments.src: After a strong September, American shoppers eased off the gas in October.
segments.tr: Nach einem starken September haben die amerikanischen Käufer im Oktober etwas Gas herausgenommen.

segments.src: Retail sales rose 0.2% for the month, according to the Census Bureau's advance estimate, following a 0.8% jump in September.
segments.tr: Die Einzelhandelsumsätze stiegen im Berichtsmonat laut der Schnellschätzung des Census Bureau um 0,2%, nach einem Sprung von 0,8% im September.

segments.src: The October figure matched what forecasters had expected, so it was not a surprise.
segments.tr: Der Oktober-Wert entsprach den Erwartungen der Prognostiker, war also keine Überraschung.

segments.src: It still gives us a useful chance to look at how consumers are behaving heading into the busiest shopping stretch of the year.
segments.tr: Er bietet uns dennoch eine nützliche Gelegenheit, zu betrachten, wie sich die Verbraucher im Hinblick auf die geschäftigste Einkaufsphase des Jahres verhalten.

segments.src: This article explains how to read the report, why fuel prices can squeeze other spending, and what the numbers may and may not tell us about the holidays.
segments.tr: Dieser Artikel erklärt, wie man den Bericht liest, warum Kraftstoffpreise andere Ausgaben eindrücken können und was die Zahlen über die Feiertage aussagen können und was nicht.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Es handelt sich um allgemeine Informationen, nicht um eine Finanzberatung.

segments.src: ## The numbers in context
segments.tr: ## Die Zahlen im Kontext

segments.src: Retail sales measure the dollar value of purchases at stores, restaurants, online retailers, gas stations and other businesses.
segments.tr: Die Einzelhandelsumsätze messen den Dollarwert der Käufe in Geschäften, Restaurants, Online-Shops, Tankstellen und anderen Unternehmen.

segments.src: The monthly report is one of the most closely watched indicators of consumer demand.
segments.tr: Der monatliche Bericht ist einer der am genauesten beobachteten Indikatoren für die Verbrauchernachfrage.

segments.src: Consumer spending makes up roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Die Konsumausgaben machen etwa zwei Drittel der US-amerikanischen

segments.src: economic activity, so shifts in shopping habits matter well beyond store aisles.
segments.tr: Wirtschaftsaktivität aus, weshalb Verschiebung im Einkaufsverhalten weit über die Laden Gänge hinaus von Bedeutung sind.

segments.src: A 0.8% gain followed by a 0.2% gain does not mean consumers have stopped spending.
segments.tr: Ein Zuwachs von 0,8%, gefolgt von einem Zuwachs von 0,2%, bedeutet nicht, dass die Verbraucher aufgehört haben auszugeben.

segments.src: Sales are still growing.
segments.tr: Die Umsätze wachsen weiterhin.

segments.src: The pace has simply cooled from an unusually strong month.
segments.tr: Das Tempo hat sich lediglich von einem ungewöhnlich starken Monat abgekühlt.

segments.src: Economists often expect some "give-back" after a big jump, because a surge in one month can pull forward purchases that would otherwise have happened later.
segments.tr: Ökonomen erwarten nach einem großen Sprung oft eine gewisse „Rückgabe“, da ein Anstieg in einem Monat Käufe vorziehen kann, die sonst später stattgefunden hätten.

segments.src: ## How to read a Census Bureau retail report
segments.tr: ## Wie man einen Einzelhandelsbericht des Census Bureau liest

segments.src: A single headline number hides a lot.
segments.tr: Eine einzelne Schlagzeilenzahl verbirgt vieles.

segments.src: A few habits help when you read the release.
segments.tr: Ein paar Gewohnheiten helfen beim Lesen der Veröffentlichung.

segments.src: Check whether the figures are adjusted.** The headline number is usually seasonally adjusted, which smooths out predictable patterns such as holiday spikes and summer travel.
segments.tr: Prüfen Sie, ob die Zahlen angepasst sind.** Die Schlagzeilenzahl ist in der Regel saisonbereinigt, was vorhersehbare Muster wie Feiertagsspitzen und Sommerreisen glättet.

segments.src: That makes month-to-month comparisons fairer.
segments.tr: Das macht Vergleiche von Monat zu Monat fairer.

segments.src: Unadjusted figures show the raw totals.
segments.tr: Unbereinigte Zahlen zeigen die Rohsummen.

segments.src: Remember that prices are not removed.** Retail sales are reported in nominal dollars.
segments.tr: Denken Sie daran, dass die Preise nicht herausgerechnet werden.** Die Einzelhandelsumsätze werden in nominalen US-Dollar gemeldet.

segments.src: If prices rise 0.3% in a month, sales can grow 0.2% while the actual quantity of goods bought falls slightly.
segments.tr: Wenn die Preise in einem Monat um 0,3% steigen, können die Umsätze um 0,2% wachsen, während die tatsächliche Menge der gekauften Waren leicht sinkt.

segments.src: Comparing the sales figure with inflation data gives a better picture of real demand.
segments.tr: Der Vergleich der Umsatzzahlen mit Inflationsdaten liefert ein besseres Bild der realen Nachfrage.

segments.src: Expect revisions.** The first estimate is an "advance" reading based on a sample of businesses.
segments.tr: Rechnen Sie mit Revisionen.** Die erste Schätzung ist ein „Vorabwert“ auf Basis einer Stichprobe von Unternehmen.

segments.src: It is often revised in later releases, sometimes meaningfully.
segments.tr: Sie wird in späteren Veröffentlichungen oft revidiert, manchmal erheblich.

segments.src: A 0.2% reading could later be adjusted up or down, and the prior month's number can change too.
segments.tr: Ein Wert von 0,2% könnte später nach oben oder unten korrigiert werden, und auch die Zahl des Vormonats kann sich ändern.

segments.src: Look beneath the top line.** The report breaks sales into categories, including motor vehicles, building materials, grocery stores, restaurants, clothing, electronics and online retail.
segments.tr: Blicken Sie hinter die Hauptzahlen.** Der Bericht unterteilt die Umsätze in Kategorien, darunter Kraftfahrzeuge, Baumaterialien, Lebensmittelgeschäfte, Restaurants, Bekleidung, Elektronik und Online-Einzelhandel.

segments.src: Many analysts also look at a narrower measure that excludes autos and gasoline, since those two categories can swing sharply with prices and supply and may obscure underlying trends.
segments.tr: Viele Analysten betrachten auch ein engeres Maß, das Autos und Benzin ausschließt, da diese beiden Kategorien bei Preisen und Angebot stark schwanken können und zugrundeliegende Trends verschleiern können.

segments.src: Compare against expectations.** Markets and commentators react less to the raw figure than to how it compares with forecasts.
segments.tr: Vergleichen Sie mit den Erwartungen.** Märkte und Kommentatoren reagieren weniger auf die Rohzahl als darauf, wie sie im Vergleich zu Prognosen abschneidet.

segments.src: A result in line with consensus, as in October, usually signals continuity rather than a turning point.
segments.tr: Ein Ergebnis im Einklang mit dem Konsens signalisiert, wie im Oktober, in der Regel Kontinuität statt eines Wendepunkts.

segments.src: ## Why gasoline can crowd out other spending
segments.tr: ## Warum Benzin andere Ausgaben verdrängen kann

segments.src: Gas stations count as retail sales, so higher pump prices can lift the headline number even when people are not buying more of anything.
segments.tr: Tankstellen zählen zu den Einzelhandelsumsätzen, sodass höhere Zapfsäulenpreise die Schlagzeilenzahl nach oben treiben können, selbst wenn die Menschen nicht mehr von irgendetwas kaufen.

segments.src: Households do not have unlimited budgets, though.
segments.tr: Haushalte haben jedoch keine unbegrenzten Budgets.

segments.src: When a bigger share of income goes to fuel, there is less left for discretionary items like clothing, electronics, dining out and gifts.
segments.tr: Wenn ein größerer Anteil des Einkommens für Kraftstoff aufgewendet wird, bleibt weniger für diskretionäre Posten wie Kleidung, Elektronik, Restaurantbesuche und Geschenke übrig.

segments.src: That effect works in two directions:
segments.tr: Dieser Effekt wirkt in zwei Richtungen:

segments.src: - **Headline versus underlying strength.** A rise in fuel prices can make total sales look healthier than the rest of the economy actually is. Falling fuel prices can do the opposite, dragging down the total while leaving more money in household budgets for other purchases.
segments.tr: - **Schlagzeile versus zugrundeliegende Stärke.** Ein Anstieg der Treibstoffpreise kann die Gesamtumsätze gesünder erscheinen lassen, als der Rest der Wirtschaft tatsächlich ist. Sinkende Treibstoffpreise können das Gegenteil bewirken und das Gesamtergebnis nach unten ziehen, während sie in den Haushaltsbudgets mehr Geld für andere Einkäufe belassen.

segments.src: - **Squeezed budgets.** Gas is a necessity for most commuters. When it costs more, many families cut elsewhere, often on non-essential categories first. Lower-income households, which spend a larger share of income on fuel and other basics, tend to feel this most.
segments.tr: - **Eingeschränkte Budgets.** Benzin ist für die meisten Pendler eine Notwendigkeit. Wenn es teurer wird, kürzen viele Familien anderswo, oft zuerst bei nicht-essenziellen Kategorien. Haushalte mit niedrigerem Einkommen, die einen größeren Anteil ihres Einkommens für Treibstoff und andere Grundlagen ausgeben, spüren dies am stärksten.

segments.src: This is why economists look at the "control group" and ex-gasoline measures as well as the total.
segments.tr: Aus diesem Grund betrachten Ökonomen die „Kontrollgruppe“ und Maße ohne Benzin ebenso wie die Gesamtsumme.

segments.src: They help separate real changes in shopping behavior from price movements in a single category.
segments.tr: Sie helfen dabei, reale Veränderungen im Einkaufsverhalten von Preisbewegungen in einer einzigen Kategorie zu trennen.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for holiday sales
segments.tr: ## Was dies für das Weihnachtsgeschäft bedeuten könnte

segments.src: It is tempting to treat one month of data as a forecast for November and December.
segments.tr: Es ist verlockend, einen Monat Daten als Prognose für November und Dezember zu behandeln.

segments.src: That would overreach.
segments.tr: Das würde zu weit gehen.

segments.src: Still, a few points are reasonable.
segments.tr: Dennoch sind einige Punkte vernünftig.

segments.src: **Steady, not spectacular.** A modest gain suggests consumers are still spending but are more selective.
segments.tr: **Stetig, nicht spektakulär.** Ein bescheidener Zuwachs deutet darauf hin, dass die Verbraucher immer noch Geld ausgeben, aber wählerischer sind.

segments.src: Retailers may see a season that grows at a moderate pace rather than one driven by a rush of impulse buying.
segments.tr: Einzelhändler erleben möglicherweise eine Saison, die in mäßigem Tempo wächst, statt einer, die durch einen Ansturm von Spontankäufen angetrieben wird.

segments.src: **Promotions matter.** When shoppers are cautious, discounts and early sales events tend to carry more weight.
segments.tr: **Werbeaktionen sind wichtig.** Wenn Käufer vorsichtig sind, haben Rabatte und frühe Verkaufsveranstaltungen tendenziell ein größeres Gewicht.

segments.src: Many retailers already start holiday promotions in October, which may pull some demand forward and affect how monthly numbers look.
segments.tr: Viele Einzelhändler starten bereits im Oktober Weihnachtsaktionen, was einen Teil der Nachfrage vorziehen und das Aussehen der monatlichen Zahlen beeinflussen kann.

segments.src: **Online keeps gaining share.** Over the long run, e-commerce has taken a growing portion of retail spending.
segments.tr: **Online gewinnt weiter an Anteilen.** Langfristig hat der E-Commerce einen wachsenden Teil der Einzelhandelsausgaben übernommen.

segments.src: Holiday results for physical stores and online sellers often diverge, so category detail is worth watching.
segments.tr: Die Weihnachtsergebnisse für physische Geschäfte und Online-Verkäufer driften oft auseinander, daher lohnt es sich, die Kategoriedetails im Auge zu behalten.

segments.src: **The big drivers are still ahead.** Employment, wage growth, borrowing costs and consumer confidence will shape the rest of the season.
segments.tr: **Die großen Treiber stehen noch bevor.** Beschäftigung, Lohnwachstum, Kreditkosten und Verbrauchervertrauen werden den Rest der Saison prägen.

segments.src: So will weather, shipping capacity and the timing of major sales days.
segments.tr: Das Gleiche gilt für das Wetter, die Versandkapazitäten und das Timing wichtiger Verkaufstage.

segments.src: No single data point settles the outcome.
segments.tr: Kein einzelner Datenpunkt entscheidet das Ergebnis allein.

segments.src: ## Practical takeaways for shoppers
segments.tr: ## Praktische Erkenntnisse für Käufer

segments.src: If you are planning your own holiday budget, the broader story is less important than your own finances.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie Ihr eigenes Urlaubsbudget planen, ist die breitere Geschichte weniger wichtig als Ihre eigenen Finanzen.

segments.src: A few simple steps can help:
segments.tr: Ein paar einfache Schritte können helfen:

segments.src: - Set a total spending limit before shopping starts, and divide it among gifts, travel and food.
segments.tr: - Setzen Sie sich vor Beginn des Einkaufs ein Gesamtbudget für Ausgaben und teilen Sie es auf Geschenke, Reisen und Lebensmittel auf.

segments.src: - Compare prices across several retailers, and check return policies.
segments.tr: - Vergleichen Sie Preise bei mehreren Einzelhändlern und prüfen Sie die Rückgaberichtlinien.

segments.src: - Be wary of "limited time" pressure. A real bargain will usually still be a bargain tomorrow.
segments.tr: - Seien Sie vorsichtig bei Druck durch „begrenzte Zeit“. Ein echtes Schnäppchen ist morgen meist immer noch ein Schnäppchen.

segments.src: - Try to avoid putting purchases on credit cards you cannot pay off promptly, since interest can erase any savings from a sale.
segments.tr: - Versuchen Sie zu vermeiden, Einkäufe auf Kreditkarten zu tätigen, die Sie nicht umgehend abbezahlen können, da Zinsen jegliche Ersparnisse durch einen Verkauf zunichte machen können.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Fazit

segments.src: October's 0.2% increase shows a consumer who is still spending but at a calmer pace after September's burst.
segments.tr: Der Anstieg von 0,2% im Oktober zeigt einen Verbraucher, der nach dem Ausbruch im September immer noch Geld ausgibt, jedoch in einem ruhigeren Tempo.

segments.src: Because the result matched expectations, it is best read as a sign of continuity.
segments.tr: Da das Ergebnis den Erwartungen entsprach, wird es am besten als Zeichen der Kontinuität interpretiert.

segments.src: For the holidays, the more useful questions are how much of the gain came from price changes rather than real purchases, how households are handling fuel and other living costs, and what the next reports show.
segments.tr: Für die Feiertage sind die nützlicheren Fragen, wie viel des Zuwachses aus Preisänderungen statt realen Käufen stammte, wie Haushalte mit Kraftstoff und anderen Lebenshaltungskosten umgehen und was die nächsten Berichte zeigen werden.

segments.src: Revisions and new data in the coming weeks will provide a clearer picture.

segments.tr: Nó thường được điều chỉnh trong các bản phát hành sau, đôi khi có ý nghĩa quan trọng.
